items:
408 Blue Mountain by Royal Destinations

Location: Blue Mountain Beach
Address: 408 Blue Mountain Road

Details:
Welcome to our Gulf front home, 408 Blue Mountain! Visitors looking for modern luxury right in the heart of 30A, in Blue Mountain Beach, will fall in love with the heart-stopping views, private beachfront access, large private pool, and outdoor kitchen with plenty of space to entertain. This light and airy home with two balconies overlooking the beach takes full advantage of beach frontage, designed so that most rooms have spectacular views. From the coastal decor to the amazing outdoor spaces, this home is sure to impress. Simply relax and watch the sun set over the Gulf of Mexico on the second-floor porch or take a dip in the private pool that overlooks the pristine, white beaches of the Emerald Coast.

If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental.

Home Highlights:
-Distance to Beach Access: Gulf Front
-Parking Spaces: 4 in Driveway, 1 in Garage
-Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 14, Bar Seating for 8.
-Coffee Maker Available
-Elevator
-*Private Heated Pool: 10’ x 30’
*Pool heat is available for an additional $330 (pre-tax)
*The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees.
*Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay.

Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements:
Sleeps: 16
6 Bedrooms / 6 Full & 2 Half Baths

First Floor:
-Bedroom 1 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Soaking Tub and Shower)
-Kitchen / Dining Area (Table seating for 10, Bar Seating for 4) / Living Room
- Pool Bathroom Located in Laundry Room (Shower)

Second Floor:
-Bedroom 2 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Soaking Tub and Shower)
-Bedroom 3: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower)
-Bedroom 4: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower/Tub Combo)
-Bedroom 5: King Bed with Shared Bath (Shower/Tub Combo)
-Bunk Room: (2) Full/Full Bunk Beds and (1) Twin/Twin Bunk Beds with Shared Bath (Shower/Tub Combo)
-Kitchenette / Dining Area (Table seating for 4, Bar Seating for 4) / Living Room

Amenities Include:
-6 Adult Bikes
-1 Beach Service Set*
*Seasonal: March - October

Please Note:
*Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival.

Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

description:
Located in Blue Mountain Beach, a neighborhood in Santa Rosa Beach, this vacation home is near theme parks and on the beach. While the natural beauty of Grayton Beach State Park and Blue Mountain Beach can be enjoyed by anyone, those looking for an activity can check out Sandestin Golf Resort - Raven, Burnt Pine, Baytowne, The Links. 
Sundog Books and Eden Gardens State Park are also worth visiting. Discover the area's water adventures with scuba diving and snorkeling nearby, or enjoy the great outdoors with cycling and hiking.
